The '''''Smokeswimmer''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] that was used by the [[Black Hammer pirates]], a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that operated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Galantos]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Stima Ardella]], the leader of the Black Hammers, and she used the vessel to raid traffic that passed along the [[Widek Bypass]].<ref name="CCW" />
